commitSubject: Let the dashboard load the fonts it was designed in
//counts: Floors and ceilings, not equalities, and they must hold in BOTH environments. Without TEST_DATABASE_URL: 1385/936/442/7. With a test database configured: 1385/1381/0/4. The recorded numbers are the no-database ones — the floor on passing and the ceiling on skipping — so a configured machine passes comfortably and an unconfigured one passes exactly.
//skipReason: 442 tests skip when TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset, which is the committed default (server/.env is gitignored). A skipped suite proves NOTHING. Configuring a test database turns all 442 back on: 1381 passing, 0 skipped, 4 failing. The website builder keeps as much as possible out of that gate — the block contract, the theme, the renderer, the web-address rules, image identification, the subdomain host resolver and the tracked-link rules are all database-free and always run.
